what.title: What is BPD? Prevalence, symptoms, sex ratio and stigma
what.description: How common borderline personality disorder is in the community, clinics and by age, why clinic samples skew female, core features and person-first language.

emotion.title: BPD emotion dysregulation: the emotion wave, triggers and EMA
emotion.description: Scrub a schematic BPD emotion wave from trigger to peak and slow return, see the urge-relief-shame cycle, and compute mood instability (MSSD) live.

causes.title: BPD causes: the biosocial model, childhood adversity and risk factors
causes.description: Scrub the biosocial model from birth to 25, compare abuse, neglect and bullying odds ratios, and see why most exposed children never develop BPD.

genes.title: Is BPD genetic? Twin studies, heritability and polygenic risk
genes.description: BPD heritability of 35-69% in twins and 46% in a Swedish register, family risk by relatedness, the 11-locus GWAS, and what it means for one family.

brain.title: BPD and the brain: amygdala, prefrontal cortex, cortisol and pain
brain.description: Animated meta-analyses of amygdala, prefrontal, hippocampus, cortisol, opioid and oxytocin findings in BPD, with a replication board rating each one.

criteria.title: BPD DSM-5-TR criteria: the nine criteria and a 5-of-9 counter
criteria.description: The nine DSM-5-TR criteria for borderline personality disorder, why 5 of 9 gives 256 combinations, how common each criterion is, and a teaching counter.

icd.title: ICD-11 personality disorder, borderline pattern and the DSM-5 AMPD
icd.description: How ICD-11 grades personality disorder as mild, moderate or severe, its five trait domains, the 6D11.5 borderline pattern, and the DSM-5-TR alternative model.

assess.title: BPD assessment: MSI-BPD screening, SCID-5-PD and DIB-R interviews
assess.description: How borderline personality disorder is assessed: MSI-BPD cut-off and accuracy, structured interviews, BSL-23, ZAN-BPD and a predictive-value calculator.

differential.title: BPD vs bipolar, complex PTSD, ADHD and depression: differential
differential.description: Telling BPD from bipolar II, complex PTSD, ADHD, depression and autism: mood time scales, identity, triggers, impulsivity, and how often they co-occur.

dbt.title: Dialectical behaviour therapy (DBT) for BPD: skills, modes and trials
dbt.description: Watch a year of DBT fill its four skills modules and modes, build and break a behaviour chain, and see what Linehan, McMain, DBT-A and Cochrane trials found.

mbt.title: Mentalization-based treatment (MBT) for BPD: modes and trial evidence
mbt.description: How mentalizing fails under attachment stress, the three pre-mentalizing modes, and MBT trial results from Bateman & Fonagy 1999 to Cochrane 2020.

schema.title: Schema therapy and TFP for BPD: schema modes, splitting and trials
schema.description: Schema modes and Kernberg's splitting animated, with the Giesen-Bloo trial (52% vs 29% recovered), group schema therapy and TFP outcomes compared.

gpm.title: Good psychiatric management (GPM) for BPD: stepped care and evidence
gpm.description: How GPM and stepped care work for BPD: diagnosis disclosure, STEPPS, crisis care, and trials showing DBT and GPM gave equal outcomes.

compare.title: BPD therapies compared: DBT, MBT, schema therapy and TFP evidence
compare.description: Forest plot of BPD psychotherapy trials: DBT, MBT, schema therapy, TFP, GPM and STEPPS vs usual care and head-to-head, with GRADE certainty and dropout.

meds.title: BPD medication evidence: lamotrigine, antipsychotics and Cochrane
meds.description: No medicine is approved for BPD. See what Cochrane 2022 and trials such as LABILE found, why prescriptions pile up, and what NICE and APA say about review.

crisis.title: BPD suicide and self-harm safety: safety planning and crisis care
crisis.description: How a safety plan works, chronic vs acute suicide risk in BPD, why risk scales should not predict, published long-term outcomes and where to get help.

frontier.title: New BPD treatments: research pipeline, trials and evidence levels
frontier.description: Brain stimulation, ketamine, psilocybin, apps, briefer therapy and early help for BPD: each trial with its evidence label, and how DBT reached guidelines.

course.title: BPD course and recovery: remission rates over 16 years (MSAD, CLPS)
course.description: How BPD changes over time: 99% remission and 60% recovery in the 16-year McLean study, the 10-year CLPS results, and which symptoms fade first.

families.title: BPD and families: validation, Family Connections and carer support
families.description: See how validating replies calm an emotion wave, what Family Connections studies found for carer burden and grief, and how carers can look after themselves.

living.title: Living with BPD: work, relationships, pregnancy, health and stigma
living.description: A week with borderline personality disorder: how skills and supports shorten emotion waves, with cited facts on work, study, parenting, health and stigma.

nursing.title: Nursing care in BPD: ED, ward and community, with practice replies
nursing.description: Nursing care for borderline personality disorder: ED to ward to follow-up, NICE guidance, validating replies that hold boundaries, training and Safewards.

history.title: History of borderline personality disorder: from Stern 1938 to ICD-11
history.description: Animated timeline of BPD from Stern's 1938 border line group to DSM-III, DBT, recovery studies and ICD-11, with the people behind each idea and a quiz game.

review.title: BPD flashcards and mnemonics: DSM-5-TR criteria, DBT, MBT, recovery
review.description: 88 cited flashcards on borderline personality disorder by part, ten memory aids and an animated R-S-A-I + 9 guide to the nine DSM-5-TR criteria.

quiz.title: BPD quiz: 98 cited questions on diagnosis, therapy and safety
quiz.description: Multiple-choice quiz on borderline personality disorder with cited answers: criteria, ICD-11, DBT and MBT trials, medicines, crisis care and nursing cases.

glossary.title: BPD glossary: borderline personality disorder terms explained
glossary.description: 180 searchable, cited terms on borderline personality disorder, from affective instability and mentalizing to ZAN-BPD, safety planning and Safewards.

sources.title: BPD Companion sources: references behind every claim
sources.description: Every journal article, Cochrane review, guideline, drug label and trial record behind the BPD Companion, searchable and filterable by research area.
